desc: Parse input; set a=min(S,T), b=max(S,T), sign=+1 if S<T else -1.
Same-a / same-b conflicts via last-occurrence scan to fill prev[j].
Same-sign crossing via bottom-up CDQ merge (pattern A sweep: insert left i with a_i<a_j at coord b_i, range-max over b in (a_j,b_j)) with a version-stamped segment tree.
Pattern B handled by mirror run a'=N+1-b, b'=N+1-a.
Build pref[R]=max_{j<=R} prev[j]; print "Yes" if pref[R]<L else "No".

Independently verify the "feasible iff no pairwise conflict" reduction and the CDQ/mirror/segment-tree implementation with a brute-force feasibility checker over exhaustive small cases; no mismatches found and both public samples pass.
